title: Kayaking game
author: wingedsheep38
selftext:
I vibe coded a pixel art island for my personal website.  
One of the "secrets" hidden on the island is that when you click the kayak you get a mini game.

The game lets you take the kayak on the river. There are rivers of increasing difficulty, and all of them are procedurally generated. 

To verify if it is actually possible to kayak down the rivers without hitting any rocks I created an auto pilot that can kayak the rivers many times to test for flaws that need improving.

You can try it out on [https://wingedsheep.com/](https://wingedsheep.com/)
